entities.name: Jacques-René Tenon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jacques-René Tenon was a French surgeon born in Sépeaux in northern Burgundy. He was very active in hospital reform during the second half of the 18th century. His seminal treatise on hospital design and management, the Mémoire sur les hôpitaux de Paris, proved to be influential in Europe for more than a century.

His seminal treatise on hospital design and management, the Mémoire sur les hôpitaux de Paris, proved to be influential in Europe for more than a century.
